apps/cli/src/main.ts: CLI process entry: runs the command program once with runPromiseExit and maps the exit to the process exit code.
apps/desktop/src/main/index.ts: Electron main entry: app lifecycle events and IPC handlers are Promise callbacks that run desktop effects.
apps/desktop/src/main/runtime.ts: Desktop runtime-process wiring (transitional): RuntimeLifecycle takes a Promise health check until desktop services become layers.
apps/desktop/src/main/shutdown.ts: Electron quit boundary (transitional): the quit handler runs the desktop-services shutdown effect until desktop composition owns shutdown.
apps/desktop/src/main/updater/desktop-up: IPC boundary: each update intent from the renderer runs one updater effect.
apps/runtime/src/platform/http/route-run: HTTP/WebSocket boundary: the one place a Fastify request or socket callback becomes a fiber on the server request runtime (RouteRuntime.runPromise in runRouteRequest; RouteRuntime.runFork for the post-200 content-stream failure log).
apps/runtime/src/pty-processes/stream-ro: PTY WebSocket boundary: forks one scoped connection fiber per socket on the RouteRuntime.
apps/runtime/src/runtime-events/api.ts: Runtime-events WebSocket boundary: forks one scoped connection fiber per socket on the RouteRuntime.
apps/runtime/src/workflows/checkpoints/c: Transitional deep run: Promise-based checkpoint capture calls the content store; phase 3 makes capture an Effect.
apps/runtime/src/workflows/checkpoints/m: Transitional deep run: Promise-based checkpoint mirroring opens content-store entries; phase 3 makes mirroring an Effect.
apps/runtime/src/workflows/engine/enviro: Workflow SDK Promise bridge: placement() context methods are part of the public Promise-shaped authoring contract.
apps/runtime/src/workflows/operations/co: Workflow SDK Promise bridge: operation-context methods are part of the public Promise-shaped authoring contract.
apps/runtime/src/workflows/store/content: Transitional deep run: runSync inside the GC reference lookup and a setInterval GC tick; phase 3 moves GC onto a scheduled scoped fiber.
apps/web/src/lib/runtime/run.ts: Web boundary (transitional): runRuntimeEffect runs runtime-client effects for React callers until the atom runtime replaces it.
apps/web/src/lib/workspace/terminal-cach: Web boundary (transitional): a synchronously owned Scope for terminal resources whose browser cleanup APIs are synchronous.
scripts/dev-supervisor/controller.mjs: Script entry: the dev-supervisor controller process runs its program once.
scripts/dev-supervisor/signal-fixture.mj: Script entry: test fixture process that supervises children for the signal-handling tests.
scripts/sync-package-versions.mjs: Script entry: runs the version-sync CLI program once.
scripts/verify-package-versions.mjs: Script entry: runs the version-verify CLI program once.
